comments.author: Igor
comments.body: What is the max number of optional skills that can be added to a xebec? I added a improved rudder and enchance ship handling and they appeared on the ship, but then I added a flotsam search and it doesnt appear as being on the ship, so i am wondering if option skills are maxed at 2.

comments.author: Carla
comments.body:
yes optional skills are maxed at two
you can add an additional skill but must be done as an original ship skill
